redFlags.note: Conflict: K. Collantine, RaceFans, 5 Dec 2021: 'originally stopped on the 14th lap' (https://www.racefans.net/?p=467498); Speedcafe: 'under red flag with 14 of 50 scheduled laps complete' and 'a Lap 14 restart'. Jolpica: leader's lap 14 holds the stoppage (1190s), so the 14 in those reports is the stoppage lap; the flag was shown on lap 13. Standing restart on lap 15 (Ocon, Hamilton, Verstappen order).

Elson, 5 Dec 2021): 'Once the race got underway for a third time on Lap 17' (https://motorsportmagazine.com/articles/single-seaters/f1/hamilton-emerges-from-chaos-to-win-2021-saudi-arabian-gp-lap-by-lap); RaceFans: 'red-flagged twice by the 16th lap' (https://www.racefans.net/?p=467498)
redFlags.note: Conflict: Motor Sport says 'The red flag was brought out again on Lap 16'. Jolpica: leader's lap 15 took 217s (the restart lap, cut short) and lap 16 holds the stoppage (1295s), the same pattern as the first red flag (shown 13, stoppage 14), so 15 taken. Caused by the Leclerc-Perez and Mazepin-Russell incidents on the restart lap. Standing restart on lap 17.
